card.title: Credit for the Discovery
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you found the clue, saw through the deception, or designed the successful scheme.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before calling it our discovery, mention who found the receipt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. After my receipt introduced it properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put your name in the report.

mechanism: A demands the report identify the precise discovery contribution instead of giving generic group or attendance credit.
confusable: Unlike wanting praise generally, A must pin acknowledgment to finding the clue that enabled the outcome.
comparison: A report's verb determines credit, while the house-tour alternative distinguishes discovery from holding a door.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
